transform_rationale.type_alias_long: Street-type abbreviation written as the full word (KR -> CARRERA); same street, digits untouched.
transform_rationale.type_alias_short: Another abbreviation of the same street type that the parser is expected to know (KR -> CRA, CL -> CLL); same street.
transform_rationale.complement_alias: Unit word spelled out (AP -> APARTAMENTO, BLQ -> BLOQUE); same unit, numbers untouched.
transform_rationale.zero_padded: Leading zeros on numbers (26 -> 026); numeric value is identical.
transform_rationale.glued_tokens: Spaces removed around type/number, '#' and '-' (CL5#10-20); same tokens, no digit changed.
transform_rationale.lowercase: Letter case only (lower or Title Case); case never carries meaning in an address.
transform_rationale.extra_whitespace: Repeated blanks between tokens; whitespace is not information.
transform_rationale.hash_to_no: '#' written as No / No. / N° / Nº; all mean 'number'.
transform_rationale.hash_absent: '#' omitted ('CL 5 10 - 20'), only for single-number streets so the split stays unambiguous; tokens and order unchanged.
transform_rationale.punctuation: Stray '.' or ',' after the street type or at the end; punctuation only.
transform_rationale.unicode_spacing: Non-breaking spaces or en/em dash instead of '-' (typical of copy/paste from documents).
transform_rationale.unicode_symbols: Full-width '#' or the numero sign; compatibility characters for the same '#'/'No'.
transform_rationale.trailing_whitespace: Leading or trailing blanks/tabs; whitespace is not information.
transform_rationale.novel_type_alias: Street-type spellings NOT in the parser tables (KR -> CARR/CRRA, AV -> AVDA/AVEN, DG -> DIAG); same street, digits untouched.
transform_rationale.novel_complement_alias: Unit-word spellings NOT in the parser tables (AP -> APT/APART, LC -> LOC, OF -> OFIC, ED -> EDIF/EDF, BLQ -> BLOQ); same unit, numbers untouched.
transform_rationale.novel_number_word: '#' written as the word NUMERO; same meaning, not in the parser tables.
transform_rationale.combo: One structural mutation followed by one or two surface mutations; each preserves identity, so the composition does too.
